rankrat 0.9.0

- Added support for more analytics and backlink providers: Cloudflare analytics, CrUX, Ahrefs, Majestic, Moz, Semrush, and DataForSEO.
- Introduced persistent site-audit monitors and issue history using a local SQLite database.
- Expanded reporting and audit tools: supports internal-link analysis, content opportunities, and Cloudflare cache operations.
- Updated documentation for new provider integrations and persistent state.
- Removed deprecated skill-card.md documentation file.

rankrat 0.8.0 introduces DNS-based ownership automation, whole-site audits, and backlink aggregation.

- Adds support for automating Google/Bing DNS ownership via a configured DNS provider adapter (Cloudflare supported)
- Introduces bounded whole-site audits with remediation reporting for metadata, canonical, robots, sitemap, links, and structured data issues
- Aggregates and reports Bing backlink evidence, now including referring-domain and anchor-text metrics
- Updates permissions and documentation to reflect new network targets (e.g., DNS provider endpoints, public DNS)
- Removes skill-card.md to streamline documentation

- Updated Docker run examples in documentation to specify user IDs and add resource limits for improved security (memory, CPU, pids).
- Clarified configuration for writable OAuth storage while keeping provider secrets read-only.
- Revised onboarding instructions and permission descriptions for agent and unbounded onboarding modes.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.
- Minor documentation cleanups in usage and metadata fields.

Initial release of rankrat — a unified, self-hosted server for querying your own search-analytics and SEO APIs.

- Supports Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and PageSpeed Insights through one MCP API.
- Provides search analytics, trends, anomaly detection, drop attribution, indexing diagnostics, ranking reports, URL/page performance, and GA4 reporting (including ecommerce and user behavior).
- Robust security: read-only by default, strict provider and property boundaries, credentials never leave the host.
- Offers stdio and HTTP MCP endpoints, plus a FastAPI-based JSON API.
- Usable for analyzing your own sites (not for competitive research or tracking arbitrary domains).
